title: Hun Vasna Nai Kadi Hun Vasna Nai Kadi
body:
Mei Suneya Veer Akbar Tere Seenay Tut Gaee Barchi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehnday Nay Roz Mainu Chaali Gharan Day Jandray
Kisay Mur Kay Hun Nai Aouna Na Vaikh Roz Rastay
Aj Ton Tera Madina Kerbobala Di Basti
<<DIVIDER>>
Khawabanch Vaikhdi Si Takheer Ho Gaee Ey
Seenay Tay Ina Lillah Tehreer Ho Gaee Ey
Haider Da Khoon Haan Mei Tabeer Di Khabar Si
<<DIVIDER>>
Babay Kafan Pawa Kay Banray Da Rukh Sajaya
Valaanch Khoon Laa Kay Amri Shagan Manaya
Kaisee Baraat Kubra Kaisee Bhira Di Shaadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasid Kavay Musafir Koi Saboot Dayvayn
Kiwain Yacieen Ker Laan Sughra Da Baba Tu Eyn
Tere Aasay Paasay Akber Na Tere Kol Ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasid Nay Aa Dasaya Her Khayma Sar Gaya Si
Teri Shaadi Keetay Veeran Jera Sehra Bhaijeya Si
Tere Sir Da Sehra Amri Ona Khaymayanch Bhul Gaee
